internal.title: Incident Report: High Latency in Ad Service Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:01 UTC on 2026-11-08, a high latency alert was triggered for the ad service with p95 latency reaching 1.8 seconds. Initial diagnosis confirmed the latency issue without a corresponding increase in error rates, indicating the problem was due to latency rather than errors.

A hypothesis of resource exhaustion, specifically high CPU usage, was considered. The flag controlling CPU-related resource limits (adHighCpu) was disabled at 11:21 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery with latency returning to normal levels (p95 latency dropped to 0.12 seconds).

No direct evidence of memory leaks or other resource issues was found, but these remain plausible causes for future monitoring. The incident was resolved promptly after the flag adjustment.

Action taken:
- Disabled the adHighCpu flag to alleviate CPU resource constraints.

Please monitor the service for any recurrence and investigate further if latency issues reappear.

external.title: High Latency Issue in Ad Service Resolved
external.body:
Between 11:01 and 11:21 UTC on 2026-11-08, the ad service experienced elevated latency, causing slower response times for users. The issue was identified and resolved by adjusting system settings related to resource management. Normal service performance has been restored.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are continuing to monitor the service to prevent future occurrences.
